items.title: Counted phase program

source.anchor: Algorithm3.1, AlgorithmD.2 and D.4 final paragraph: two query arrays,2J proximal and2J direct gradient calls; component restatement with explicit finite-array/incoming-state boundary
source.attribution: Fan Chen, Sinho Chewi, Jianfeng Lu and Matthew S. Zhang; bounded ASTIS exact-real implementation component.

items.statement: For arbitrary real normed E, gradient oracle g, eta,eps,h, Fin m nodes and weights, input w and fuel:E->Nat, phaseQuery returns Option((E*E)*Nat). It first refreshes P0 and builds Y0. It sequentially executes every proximalQuery at Y0_i from Y0_i using fuel(Y0_i), and if successful evaluates g at returned point plus sqrt(eta)G0_i and adds one query to that returned count. It builds Y1 from these actual returned gradients, sequentially executes every second proximal/noisy-gradient call similarly using G1, then returns the complete phase output and the sum of both arrays actual counts. Any failed call returns none, with no successful cost certificate.
assumptions: E is an arbitrary real normed vector space; g, parameters, supplied finite nodes/weights and fuel are arbitrary. The input contains one state pair, two refresh noises and two Fin-m noise arrays; no probability or success assumption.

obligations.label: Source quadrature/global D7/D8 and main results remain open

bindings.boundary: Actual interpreter definition only. Single full Gaussian phase with supplied incoming integrable state L2 budget, finite bounded nodes and row l1 bounds; actual successful exact-real interpreter output and total gradient count. Sufficient finite fuel certifies execution and is not a runtime precomputation or a count/cost hypothesis. No cost claim for failed insufficient-fuel executions. Gaussian sampling and arithmetic are not gradient queries. Source quadrature/J adapter, run-wide D7 induction, D8 parameter/iteration substitution, Wp, proxy-warmness, initialization, PBPS and composition/main results remain open. No TV-to-unbounded-cost transfer.
